avis.titre: Soo good I wear it everyday
avis.texte: The Perfect Everyday Mineral Sunscreen Cetaphil's Sheer Mineral Face Liquid Drops SPF 50 has become my absolute go-to for daily sun protection. After trying countless mineral sunscreens that left me looking like a ghost, this one truly impressed me with its innovative, lightweight formula. First off, the packaging is fantastic. The small bottle with a precise dropper top makes it incredibly easy to control how much product you use, which is a big plus for a liquid sunscreen. It's also compact and travel-friendly. The texture is what truly sets this sunscreen apart. It's a very fluid, almost serum-like consistency that glides on effortlessly. Unlike thicker zinc oxide formulas, it blends in quickly and feels feather-light on the skin, leaving a beautiful matte finish. The "sheer" claim is accurate, as it minimizes the dreaded white cast, making it a great option for a wide range of skin tones. It also works perfectly as a primer, creating a smooth base for makeup without any pilling or greasiness. As for the scent, there's practically none. It's fragrance-free, which is a major benefit for anyone with sensitive or reactive skin. The lack of a strong, overpowering sunscreen smell makes it a pleasure to apply every morning. Most importantly, the sun protection is reliable and effective. With a broad-spectrum SPF 50 and 100% mineral active ingredients (zinc oxide), I feel confident that my skin is well-protected against both UVA and UVB rays. It's also water-resistant for up to 8

I've been using Cetaphil products for the past 20 years, and with very few exceptions, it has treated my sensitive, acne-prone skin well. This product is one of those exceptions. I recently used this during a summer vacation (preceded by Cetaphil Gentle Skin Cleanser, aloe vera gel; and Cetaphil gentle moisturizer), and within a few days of regular use, my face started to breakout. I ended up with a giant, red pimple on the side of my nose and a whitehead by one of my eyebrows. Once I figured out what was happening, I stopped using this, and aside from the painful acne that had already formed, the rest of skin went back to normal, and I resumed my daily Cetaphil SPF 15 moisturizer, which as been my go-to for a long time. Fortunately, this product worked well for my wife and kids, so I'm giving it three stars, but I will never touch it again.

I've been using the Cetaphil Sheer Mineral Face Liquid Sunscreen SPF 50 for a few weeks now, and it's become a staple in my skincare routine. The lightweight, serum-like texture applies smoothly and absorbs quickly, leaving a matte finish that's perfect under makeup. As someone with sensitive skin, I appreciate that it's fragrance-free, non-comedogenic, and doesn't cause any irritation. The broad-spectrum protection with 12% zinc oxide gives me confidence that I'm shielded from UVA and UVB rays. While it claims to be sheer, I did notice a slight white cast upon application, but it fades as the product settles. Overall, it's a reliable, gentle sunscreen that I would recommend to anyone with sensitive or acne-prone skin. Pros: Lightweight, non-greasy formula Fragrance-free and suitable for sensitive skin Matte finish ideal for layering under makeup Broad-spectrum SPF 50 protection Cons: Slight white cast upon initial application Would I repurchase? Absolutely! It's a great addition to any skincare regimen.

I used a lot brand different sunscreen but I like it cetaphil . It is good product , my face doesn't oil , good skin , coverage face , I'm feeling comfortable . It is small I can travel bring it . My skin very sentive skin it is good price . The best for sun creen for face

avis.titre: Amazing, but wish they had a tinted version
avis.texte: When i first bought this, i thought it was horrible because it does leave you purple-ish at first but it takes awhile for it to sink into your skin. The texture is very watery, it will run down your fingers/ hands when it's out of the bottle but it makes it easy to spread. it is not hydrating so if you are a little bit on the dry skin type like me, it's best to moisturize prior to application. The packaging is great, the sunscreen doesn't come out unless squeezed and i have never had it leak. It is eczema friendly which is a plus as well. The only con I had to this is that i wish they had a tinted version!

This is easy to apply. I was scared it give me white flash but it worked so well. My skin is light completed and I used it after getting a bad sunburn. It helped prevent further damage and did its job. Obviously you have to reapply but for the affordability I think it's a good buy. The size is convenient as well. I have sensitive skin and this did not cause me to break out in acne or a rash.
I liked it when I first applied it. However it made my skin painfully dry and itchy. What a waste.

This is my everyday sunscreen which i use over cetaphil moisturizer. I've been using this product since last 3 yrs and I'm completely satisfied with it as it does not leave any white cast. It blends perfectly and everyday makeup can be put up easily on top without damaging skin. No weird fragrance or residue. It's an absolute worthy item to have and good product with an amazing price.

avis.titre: Good protection and doenst care a breakout
avis.texte: I love this sunscreen but it is a little too liqudy for my face. It's hard to get all in my skin but when i do use it i love it. I use it on top of my normal spf. Amazing coverage and I never break out
Good sun protection, non comedonic very light even if its mineral sunscreen. Recommend who have sensitive skin. Very lightweight and absorb very well.

If I could rate zero stars I would. I bought this bc it states for sensitive skin. I used this for vacation the first day and after applying to my face within an hour my face was burning. I immediately washed it off and it actually burned my skin. I also had bumps and swelling to my neck. If your prone to other brand names that have done this don't use this product. I have used others and I had the same results. Not sure if there really is a product out there for really sensitive skin.

I've always had bad experiences with sunscreen and this is the first one that's hitting all the marks for me. I've been using it for a few months now and I feel like my skin has improved so much. My acne spots are fading. The sunscreen feels great on my skin, blends in really well, and doesn't pill under makeup! I have really sensitive skin so I was worried how it'd react to this, but its been loving it!

I wanted to love this sunscreen. Finally a zinc product that doesn't leave a white residue and doesn't feel like wallpaper paste! I used it twice and got sunburned on my face and my neck where I put it. The rest of my body I had copper Tong 55 and didn't get any sun at all. I feel like maybe this is meant to be a very light product to wear on a daily basis under make up and not for use at the beach. I live in Florida and thought this would be a great beach sunscreen, but I guess I was wrong.

Great sunscreen! Good protection I go hiking all the time and good sun protection is very important for me. This sunscreen provides great coverage without leaving white residue. I have sensitive skin and break out easily. Haven't had a problem using this sunscreen. The price is also fair.
I have a oily and acne prone skin love this mineral sunscreen its light weight and does not break me out. I hope cetaphil makes a tinted one with the same formula.

avis.titre: Feels Light,  Slight White cast that goes away fast
avis.texte: I like the consistency of this product, it goes white on the skin but after is absorbed it looks very pretty. It feels light, there's no scent and in my opinion is a great sunscreen for the price.
Light texture to absorpt the skin. Skin tone is white up and natural. Scent and packaging is good. This brand I believe the safety. Small bottle you can put in bag.

I bought this because Cetaphil is a good brand. Unfortunately it is not suitable for people with very sensitive skin. After 5 minutes of it on my face I felt a burning sensation & it did not go away. I figured I'd leave it on for a little bit to see if it would go away but it didn't after an hour so I had to wash it off. Please make something similar but for people with sensitive skin. There is some ingredient in it that is irritating
I love this mineral sunscreen. It works really good, its very easy to use, it doesn't leave the white residue behind. It has no smell very good for sensitive skin.

This product has great coverage and does not cause breakouts. It is difficult to run in and leaves a white tint. Enjoy that it is small and easy to throw in a bag when going swimming or outside. Has minimal scent.
Not greasy at all. I used it several times already and really like how light it is. Theres no heavy perfume scent or anything. It is very well protected!

I have to tell you, the Cetaphil Sheer Mineral Face Sunscreen is a total game-changer! And guess what? It doesn't leave any of that annoying white cast on my skin. Seriously, it's like magic! This sunscreen is so lightweight and blends in like a dream, leaving my skin feeling smooth and protected without any greasy residue. Plus, it's got broad-spectrum SPF coverage, so I know I'm shielded from those pesky UVA and UVB rays. The best part? It's gentle enough for sensitive skin, which is a big win for me. Since I started using this sunscreen, my skin feels so happy and hydrated, and it's got this gorgeous radiant glow. If you're on the hunt for a sunscreen that's effective, lightweight, and won't leave you looking like a ghost, you've gotta try the Cetaphil Sheer Mineral Face Sunscreen. Trust me, it's a total must-have for your skincare routine!

avis.titre: Helps tone down the look of redness and neutral skintone.
avis.texte: This is going to sound crazy, but I buy this sunscreen specifically because it has a lot of white cast. I feel like the white cast helps tone down my redness on days when I don't feel like wearing any foundation products or color correctors. Because I have a lighter skin tone, it works for me because once I blend the product in the white cast is not as noticeable but my neural complexion ends up looking brighter and the yellow tint in my neutral skin tone gets neutralized a little bit. I also like that this product goes on dewy, which makes it super easy to spread and blend on your skin, but eventually dries down to a more matte look. The scent has a classic sunscreen smell but doesn't smell as chemically as some sunscreens tend to smell. I have noticed that my skin does not break up when I use this product.
